references.basis: Native property sets, identity categories, equality/merging, reifier inverses, type-instance Core Subjects, default name type.
XML-to-TMDM identities, instanceOf, names/variants, reification, content imports; occurrences/explicit associations specified but reader unsupported.
Map plus explicit base locator; full canonical serialization, without dropping distinguishing native properties.
Identity/category mapping, isa, characteristics, reification, literals and mergemap.

epistemicSeparation.observed: Both productive reader results, native properties, intra-map EQ checks, exact CXTM bytes, all recorded process exits and hashes.
epistemicSeparation.derived: Equivalence is expected only when the same native TMDM properties are expressed; identifiers are never removed.
epistemicSeparation.limits: Finite constructed tests demonstrate the listed common constructs; not a proof of all CTM/XTM equivalence or of complete reader implementation.

editionLimits: Public TMDM text dated 2006-06-18; public XTM text dated 2006-06-19. No independent comparison against a purchased published ISO text was performed.
Public CTM HTML identifies the 31 March 2010 draft. It is not independent evidence that every clause matches the published 2010 edition.
Public CXTM text dated 2009-01-27 is the reference used here; no separate published ISO copy was acquired. No downloads were made.
commonExpressionLimits: No non-Topic item identifier is deleted to manufacture equivalence.
XTM occurrence and explicit association support is absent; three direct probes record Unsupported rather than claiming equivalence.
Type-instance Associations/Roles are directly compared through isa/instanceOf.
Only noncyclic content imports are compared; child Map-item metadata is kept distinct from imported content.
